# mv: move function to a file
mv F y.go
-- x.go --
package m

func F() int { return 1 }

func G() int { return F() }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,5 +1,3 @@
 package m

-func F() int { return 1 }
-
 func G() int { return F() }
diff old/y.go new/y.go
--- old/y.go
+++ new/y.go
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+package m
+
+func F() int { return 1 }
